messages:
alyssa: Quick sync — final pass on landing copy for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private before we publish the launch post and lock webinar registration pages. Need clear differentiation + one canonical benchmark blurb per page.
kevin: Agree. Proposal: homepage hero stays high-level ('Predictable, production-grade LLM inference'), then mode-specific sub-heroes: Hosted = time-to-value, Dedicated = throughput/SLA, Private = compliance & on-prem. Keep CTAs consistent (Demo / Start Free).
sam: For microcopy, avoid repeating 'performance' three times. Suggest small patterns: 1) metric + benefit ("<number>% cheaper per token — keeps latency under Xms"), 2) short customer snippet. I can push concise variants for each mode by EOD.
mira: Also thinking about the launch post narrative and webinar: we should tie benchmark claims to a single repo of test harness (so it’s repeatable). For webinar registration, can we add a checkbox for "share benchmark details" to help qualify inbound leads?
alyssa: Good call. We need the benchmark snippet on the page + a gated deep-dive in the webinar. Public hero: one-liner + 3 bullets (latency, cost, reliability). Gated modal: deeper numbers and methodology.
nina: From solutions/sales POV — for Dedicated and Private pages, include a short table of typical throughputs (e.g., 4k tokens/s per GPU profile) and a callout: "custom SLA & private networking available". That helps AE qualifying calls.
devon: Technical check — forms need UTMs + a hidden field for preferred deployment (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). Also add a webhook to forward high-intent signups to Pardot/HubSpot. Example UTM we should require in URL: 
```
?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch
```
mira: For the webinar promotion, can marketing run two ad variants: 1) "How we cut inference cost by X%" (benchmark-led) and 2) "Reduce latency, keep accuracy" (reliability-led). We'll funnel ad variant to different landing sections.
kevin: One more: avoid absolute numbers that depend on model/seq length unless we qualify them. Use ranges and an explicit "Measured on: open-weights/model-X, 2k context, FP16/quantized" sentence in the gated content.
sam: I'll deliver three hero variants + one gated benchmark page mock by EOD. Alyssa — who owns the copy sign-off?
alyssa: I'll take final sign-off for the public copy. @kevin you sign off on technical accuracy. @nina you ok to own the sales callout snippets?
nina: Yep, I'll own the sales snippets and qualifying questions.
devon: I'll add the form fields + webhook in the dev ticket. Tagging the build: #web-forms.
mira: For launch timeline — target publish + first campaign next Wed. Is that still realistic?
alyssa: Yes — shipping on Wed means webinar promo starts Thu. Everyone: drop any blockers in this thread. :thumbsup:
